data.title: Pulse Radiology Institute and DeVry University Partner to Address Nationwide MRI Technologist Shortage
data.description: In Waukesha, Wisconsin on September 15, 2026, a collaboration between DeVry University and the Pulse Radiology Institute has been established in response to a significant shortage of medical imaging professionals across the country. This partnership aims to address these shortages by introducing a new MRI Technology Associate degree specialization. The program, which will be a hybrid model, is designed to combine traditional classroom learning with online coursework to provide students with a comprehensive educational experience.

data.title: In HelloNation, Home Care Expert Dan Pahos Clarifies When Families Should Consider Home Care for Seniors
data.description: Identifying the right time to consider home care for elderly parents who are having difficulty with daily tasks is crucial. In Birmingham, Alabama, on September 15, 2026, experts advised families to assess the situation when a parent is finding it challenging to handle daily activities. This includes basic tasks like meals, medication management, and personal hygiene. It is important to note that approximately 16% of seniors aged 65 and above require some form of long-term care, which often involves home care services. Recognizing these signs early on allows families to plan and ensure the senior receives the appropriate level of care they need.

data.title: In HelloNation, Financial Advisor Professional Jakub Hall Outlines How to Choose a Financial Advisor
data.description: Selecting the appropriate financial advisor requires more than just considering their credentials. By following these guidelines, individuals can ensure that they find an advisor who aligns with their financial goals and requirements.

data.title: Evers & Sons Announces Fabrication Project Award | Eleven 42-Inch Mainline Valve Assemblies
data.description: Evers & Sons, based in Houston, has recently been awarded a new fabrication project for a significant energy infrastructure initiative. The project involves the creation of eleven 42-inch mainline valve assemblies. Each assembly will comprise a 42-inch weld-end mainline valve, with pipe additions on both sides and the incorporation of a 12-inch bypass system. The comprehensive scope of work encompasses non-destructive examination (NDE), hydrotesting, coating applications, and rigorous final quality checks. Following completion, the assemblies will be readied for on-site installation. This accomplishment signifies a significant milestone for Evers & Sons in the energy sector.

This initiative brought together a total of 500 new AI capabilities, including innovative solutions for businesses. Salesforce emphasized its commitment to leveraging AI to enhance customer experience and drive growth. The event was a platform to demonstrate Salesforce's dedication to incorporating cutting-edge technology into its services, with a focus on providing value to its clients.

data.title: Air Force Evolves, Deploys Space-Control Weapons Into Orbit
data.description: During a conference on Monday, Air Force Secretary Meink announced that the U.S. military has placed space-control weapon systems in orbit. This development showcases the evolving capabilities of the Air Force, with strategic implications for national security. The deployment of these weapon systems marks a significant advancement in military technology, with potential ramifications for future space operations. This move underscores the growing emphasis on space warfare and the need for defense in this domain. The deployment of space-control weapon systems represents a shift in military strategy, demonstrating the increasing focus on space as a critical theater of operations.
